name: Capital Subsidy for Heritage Hotel under Proprietorship
benefit:
- The beneficiary receives a subsidy of 15% against the Fixed Capital Investment.
- The maximum subsidy amount is capped at ₹2,00,00,000/-.

***Benefit Disbursal Conditions***

- _The unit must be established and operationalized during the operative tenure of the policy._
- _The unit must operate continuously for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy._

_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a Proprietorship. - The applicant must be establishing a "Heritage Hotel" as a Tourism Project. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of ₹3,00,00,000/- (as approved by the department). - The applicant must have established and operationalized the project during the operative tenure of the policy. - The applicant must submit the application within 1 year from the date of commencement of operation. - The applicant must ensure the investment claimed for subsidy was made not prior to 3 years from the date of commencement of operation (or 5 years if the project was executed in one go). - The applicant must not claim Investment Promotion Assistance if claiming this capital subsidy.
